title: Construction of a Clinico-Imaging Collaborative Diagnostic Model for Dermatomyositis Combined With Interstitial Lung Disease Based on PET/CT Imaging Features and Clinical Parameters
off: Construction of a Clinico-Imaging Collaborative Diagnostic Model for Dermatomyositis Combined With Interstitial Lung Disease Based on PET/CT Imaging Features and Clinical Parameters
summary: The investigators investigated the associations between the imaging parameters of ⁶⁸Ga-FAPI and ¹⁸F-FDG dual-tracer PET/CT and concomitant interstitial lung disease (ILD) in patients with dermatomyositis (DM), developed a novel diagnostic model to predict DM complicated with ILD, and conducted external validation of this model. Meanwhile, the investigators compared the predictive performance of the imaging-only model with that of the classic clinical model and the clinical-radiological collaborative model.
desc: For the features included in the final optimal model, between-group comparisons of continuous variables (interstitial lung disease group vs. non-interstitial lung disease group) were performed using the Wilcoxon rank-sum test. For categorical variables, the Chi-square test or Fisher's exact test was adopted as appropriate.In the comparison of model efficacy, the DeLong test was used to assess the statistical differences in AUC values between each machine learning classifier and the reference model.All statistical analyses were conducted using R software (version 4.4.1). The corresponding R packages applied included pROC for ROC analysis, caret for model training, and SHAP for the interpretability analysis of the XGBoost model. A two-tailed p-value \< 0.05 was defined as the threshold of statistical significance for all analyses.
elig:
Inclusion Criteria:

1. The diagnosis of dermatomyositis (DM) was made in accordance with the Bohan and Peter criteria
2. The diagnosis of clinically amyopathic dermatomyositis (CADM) was established based on the Sontheimer criteria
3. The diagnosis of interstitial lung disease (ILD) was confirmed in line with the criteria of the American Thoracic Society (ATS)
4. ⁶⁸Ga-FAPI and ¹⁸F-FDG PET/CT scans were performed in the Department of Nuclear Medicine.

Exclusion Criteria: Patients with other connective tissue diseases.

arms.d: The diagnosis of ILD was confirmed in line with the criteria of the American Thoracic Society (ATS).
Patients in the non-ILD group had no evidence of ILD as judged by ATS criteria.

x.titre: Modèle diagnostique de pneumopathie interstitielle de la dermatomyosite par TEP/TDM double traceur
x.question: Les paramètres d'imagerie TEP/TDM au 68Ga-FAPI et au 18F-FDG permettent-ils de prédire une pneumopathie interstitielle diffuse (PID) associée à la dermatomyosite ?
x.contexte:
La PID est une complication fréquente et grave de la dermatomyosite, notamment dans les formes amyopathiques et avec anticorps anti-MDA5. Son diagnostic repose sur le scanner thoracique, les EFR et le contexte clinique. Un outil d'imagerie fonctionnelle pourrait aider à la détecter et à la caractériser plus tôt.

Le 18F-FDG reflète l'activité métabolique inflammatoire, tandis que le 68Ga-FAPI cible les fibroblastes activés et donc la fibrose. Cette étude observationnelle de l'hôpital Ruijin (Shanghai) compare des patients avec et sans PID. Elle développe, par apprentissage automatique (dont XGBoost), un modèle fondé sur l'imagerie, un modèle clinique classique et un modèle combiné, puis les valide en externe.
x.interet: Un modèle combinant imagerie et clinique pourrait améliorer la détection précoce de la PID chez les patients atteints de dermatomyosite. Les résultats restent à confirmer dans d'autres populations.
x.profil: Des adultes atteints de dermatomyosite ou de dermatomyosite amyopathique, avec ou sans PID, ayant eu une TEP/TDM double traceur.
inclusion: Ou dermatomyosite cliniquement amyopathique selon Sontheimer
PID confirmée selon les critères ATS (groupe PID)
TEP/TDM au 68Ga-FAPI et au 18F-FDG réalisées en médecine nucléaire

bras.traitement: Patients avec PID ; analyse des images et extraction de caractéristiques d'imagerie
Patients sans PID selon les critères ATS ; même analyse d'imagerie

x.critere: Caractéristiques d'imagerie TEP au 68Ga-FAPI, à l'inclusion.
